scenes.narration: Selection sort builds the sorted part from the left. Each step scans the unsorted part for its smallest value and swaps it into the next position.
scenes.caption: Find the smallest, put it next

scenes.narration: The smallest value of all is 11, at the far end. It swaps places with 64 and starts the sorted part.
scenes.caption: select 11

scenes.narration: Among 25, 12, 22 and 64, the smallest is 12. It swaps with 25.
scenes.caption: select 12

scenes.narration: Next the smallest of 25, 22 and 64 is 22, which swaps with 25.
scenes.caption: select 22

scenes.narration: The smallest of 25 and 64 is 25, and it is already in the right spot, so no swap is needed. The last value, 64, is in place too.
scenes.caption: select 25: already in place

scenes.narration: Selection sort makes few swaps, which helps when writing is expensive, but it always scans the whole unsorted part.
scenes.caption: Summary
points: Scan the unsorted part for its smallest value
Swap it to the front of that part
Always O(n squared) comparisons, at most n minus 1 swaps

quiz.question: Selection sort runs one step on 3, 1, 2. Which value does it select?
quiz.explanation: 1 is the smallest value in the whole array.

quiz.question: Selection sort runs one step on 5, 4, 3. What is the array afterwards?
quiz.explanation: 3 swaps with 5, and the array happens to be sorted.
